# United Kingdom Council Tax Discount Application

> A single-page, step-by-step application to a local council in England for a Council Tax discount, exemption, disregard or reduction. It captures the claim type (single person discount, 50% all-disregarded discount, student exemption, severe mental impairment, disabled band reduction, care-leaver relief or Council Tax Reduction), the applicant and property (band A to H), the occupant roster, the supporting evidence, the effective date and the declaration.
